name: Big Apple, 3 AM — bridge under the skyline
note: Bridge truss + night skyline + green roadway: a single band of landmark that translates ~1:1.

name: Stage 1 — Springfield street
note: Konami's 1991 Springfield: flat cartoon color blocks — exactly what a diorama reproduces best.

name: England — Dudley (London street)
note: Red double-decker bus and London street furniture — landmarks that survive translation intact.

name: Carnival — the giant clown stage
note: MvC2's signature stage: the giant clown face is a single unmistakable landmark.

name: Stage 3 — village, riding the dragon mount
note: Palisade village, cobblestones, the blue dragon mount breathing fire — the Golden Axe tableau.

name: Moonlit Ruins
note: Blue moonlit stone ruins: arches and broken columns in clean color blocks, place-forward composition.

game: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
name: Forest (side view)
Africa — Elena (savanna sunset)
note: Sunset gradient, acacia tree, fence line — pure color blocks, instantly the Africa stage.

name: Clock Tower

name: Esaka (Day)
note: Kyo's Osaka overpass plaza: giant signs + skyline in one flat stage painting, no HUD.

name: Stage 1 — neon street at night
note: Cobblestones and neon shopfronts on one plane — unmistakably the first SoR street.
